# Eigen

Header-only linear algebra, used by planegcs.

- **Origin:** Eigen 3.4.0, https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/3.4.0/eigen-3.4.0.tar.gz
  (SHA-256 `8586084f71f9bde545ee7fa6d00288b264a2b7ac3607b974e54d13e7162c1c72`)
- **Licence:** MPL-2.0 for Eigen itself; a few files carry other permissive or
  LGPL terms, described in `COPYING.README`. The licence files from the release
  are alongside.

Only the `Eigen/` directory of the release is kept.
